intro: {{nameA}} in Dehradun and {{nameB}} in Roorkee, Uttarakhand, both offer {{course}}. This page compares recorded fees, placements and ranks from our database, and flags figures that look incomplete or out of date in {{year}}.

DIT University vs Quantum University is a comparison of two private Uttarakhand universities. DIT has the only 2020 or later placement record on this page, and an older 2022 NIRF Engineering rank of 179.

sections.heading: DIT University vs Quantum University for B.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose DIT University if you want a recorded 2023 placement year and an older NIRF Engineering mention. Our records show a 2023 average of ₹10 lakh and a highest of ₹28 lakh for DIT.
Choose Quantum University only after you have seen its latest official placement and fee notices. This page has no NIRF Engineering rank for Quantum, and its latest recorded placement year is 2018.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: DIT University's recorded B.Tech tuition on this page varies widely, from about ₹1.30 lakh a year to ₹8.99 lakh a year on one row. The ₹8.99 lakh figure may be a programme total wrongly stored as a year fee, so we do not treat it as confirmed annual tuition.

Quantum University has recorded year-wise totals around ₹1.10 lakh to ₹1.25 lakh, and tuition around ₹1.30 lakh to ₹1.32 lakh a year. Confirm both official fee circulars before you compare costs, especially any DIT branch that looks unusually expensive.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: DIT University's recorded 2023 figures are an average package of ₹10 lakh and a highest package of ₹28 lakh. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.

Quantum University's latest recorded row here is from 2018, with a highest package of ₹10 lakh and no usable average. Because 2018 is older than 2020, this page does not treat it as a current flagship result.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Both universities list JEE Main on this page. DIT also lists UK SEE, the Uttarakhand state entrance route.
Class 12 PCM remains the usual academic requirement. Read the current official admissions page of each university for tests, cut-offs and scholarships.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: DIT University is in Dehradun. Quantum University is in Roorkee, in the same state but a different city. The daily commute, hill-campus feel and industry access will not be the same.
If you want to stay in Dehradun, that points toward DIT. If Roorkee is acceptable, still ask Quantum for a recent official placement report.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: On the data we hold, DIT University is the stronger documented side: a 2023 placement year and a 2022 NIRF Engineering rank of 179.
Quantum University may still suit you if its official 2026 fee and placement notices look right, but this page cannot show a current placement record or an NIRF Engineering rank for it.
Do not budget from DIT's ₹8.99 lakh year row until the university's official circular confirms what that number is.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, DIT University or Quantum University, for B.Tech?
faqs.answer: DIT has the stronger record on this page, with 2023 figures of a ₹10 lakh average and a ₹28 lakh highest package, and a 2022 NIRF Engineering rank of 179. Quantum has no NIRF Engineering rank here and no 2020 or later placement row.

faqs.question: What are the recorded B.Tech fees for DIT vs Quantum University?
faqs.answer: Quantum's recorded year fees are around ₹1.10 lakh to ₹1.32 lakh. DIT tuition rows range from about ₹1.30 lakh to ₹8.99 lakh a year; the top figure may not be a true annual fee and should be checked on DIT's official circular.

faqs.question: Which exams do DIT and Quantum University accept?
faqs.answer: Both list JEE Main. DIT also lists UK SEE. Confirm the current official admissions page of each university.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for DIT and Quantum University?
faqs.answer: DIT's recorded 2023 average is ₹10 lakh and the highest is ₹28 lakh. Quantum's latest recorded year here is 2018, which this page does not treat as a current flagship result.

faqs.question: Are DIT University and Quantum University in the same city?
faqs.answer: No. DIT is in Dehradun. Quantum University is in Roorkee. Both are in Uttarakhand, but the cities are different.
